intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Natchitoches for 2026, and here is what he found: 16 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from the 100th Natchitoches Christmas Festival of Lights (opening November 21) through January 6, with the Festival of Lights Parade and Fireworks (December 5), the Lighted Boat Parade (December 12), the Many Christmas Parade and Festival (December 12) and Cookies with Santa (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Natchitoches

  • 16 Christmas events for kids in Natchitoches
  • 3 free events, including Santa Claus House and the Fleur de Lis Christmas Craft Market
  • Meet Santa: Santa Claus House (December 8 to 23) and Cookies with Santa (November 21 and December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Festival of Lights Parade (December 5), the Lighted Boat Parade (December 12) and the Many Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Trains: none found in Natchitoches itself
  • Season: November 21 to January 6

Planning a bigger day out? Natchitoches families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Shreveport, which covers the city's holiday lights, parades, shows and Santa visits.
